description: Kernel-mystery probe: Excel's erf at tiny x with full 53-bit mantissas. Rows 1-400: x = M*2^-92 (x in [2^-40, 2^-39), so x^3 terms are about 1e-25 relative and the result depends only on how c*x is rounded). Rows 401-500: x = M*2^-80. B = ERF.PRECISE(x), C = GAMMA.DIST(x^2,0.5,1,TRUE), D = ERF(x).
